result.detail: Netlify OAuth2 apps self-registered in user settings (app.netlify.com/applications). Users authorize on their behalf. Personal access tokens also available. Docs show no vendor review, approval, verification, listing step, and no install/user cap. Only numeric limit is API rate limit (500 req/min). Part of page tail was read only as summary; OAuth app guide URL 404ed. Gate inferred from absence of any gate in docs.
result.quote: If you’re making a public integration with Netlify for others to enjoy, you must use OAuth2.
